goal: At least 1.5x updated vLLM throughput at every concurrency with full audio quality

quality.coverage: all 1088 outputs at every concurrency and every repetition; retain outliers
quality.aggregation: corpus WER across all three repetitions and mean speaker similarity across all three repetitions

hardware: one B300; same physical GPU 0 for formal comparison; no other inference on that GPU
precision: native FP8 routed experts and BF16 dense weights; no new quantization without separate quality evidence

controls.connection: fresh TCP per request; no retries

diagnostic_hypotheses: Compare native expert GEMM tactics and real routed-token occupancy across runtimes
Measure decode occupancy and time consumed by separate prompt prefill
Measure codec overlap and CPU gaps before changing scheduler language
experiment_protocol: One isolated variable per feasibility run; frozen source SHA; stop on numerical or state error; promote only complete quality and three-repeat service evidence
readme_example: Add only after every performance and quality gate passes; no partial or microbenchmark claim
